name: materialize_bounded_authoring_inputs_and_probe_declared_overrides
argv:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root.parent/'checks/audit/7860069b4149'
source=root/'generators/7860069b4149/generator.py'
sha=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha=='e9afb2c4e143072bf7f80044d40ed96eb6524615c5e7a5d17f294dcbb6d95a04'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_7860069b4149',source)
gen=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(gen)
public=json.loads((out/'public_record.json').read_text())
cases=[]
for pair in public['pairs']:
    cases.append({'name':f"canonical_{pair['split']}_{pair['pair_index']}",'kind':'canonical','input':pair['input'],'canonical_output':pair['output'],'identity':{k:pair[k] for k in ('variant','split','pair_index')},'documented_domain':'Canonical authoring data; validator agreement measured separately.'})
for band in ('easy','medium','hard'):
    for seed in range(4):
        cases.append({'name':f'baseline_{band}_{seed}','kind':'generated','seed':seed,'sample_index':0,'difficulty':band,'overrides':{},'input':gen.generate(seed,0,difficulty=band),'documented_domain':'Ordinary baseline generator output.'})
def make(h,w,coords,anchor,color=4):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in coords:g[r][c]=color
    g[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]=9
    return g
def rect(r,c,h=2,w=2):return [(rr,cc) for rr in range(r,r+h) for cc in range(c,c+w)]
def add(name,g,domain,why):cases.append({'name':name,'kind':'authored','input':g,'documented_domain':domain,'purpose':why})
add('one_step_right',make(6,8,rect(2,5),(2,4)),'Inside explicit invariants: one monochrome2x2, adjacent left9, exactlyoneavailable rightward step; allowed6x8 size.','Off-by-one validator rejection.')
add('two_step_right_control',make(6,8,rect(2,4),(2,3)),'Inside explicit invariants; two available rightward steps.','Positive boundary control.')
add('one_step_down',make(6,8,rect(3,3),(2,3)),'Inside geometric invariants and reference/written rule; direction outside default anchor_side=left axis.','Directional validator asymmetry at one step.')
add('upward_2x2',make(7,9,rect(3,3),(5,3)),'Inside geometric invariants and reference/written rule; direction outside default anchor_side=left axis.','Valid upward sweep absent from default generation and canonical pairs.')
add('foreground_one',make(6,8,rect(2,2),(3,1),1),'Inside explicit color-count and geometric invariants: foreground1 plus fixed anchor9.','Foreground1 omitted by the generator color list.')
U=[(1,2),(1,6),(2,2),(2,6)]+[(3,c) for c in range(2,7)]
add('concave_scanline_gap',make(6,8,U,(1,1)),'Inside canonical written whole-component sweep semantics, one connected monochromeUshape, adjacent anchor and room; outside current exact2x2 generator summary/validator.','Refute canonical-fitting scanline-convexification rival.')
add('rectangle_2x3_one_step',make(6,8,rect(2,4,2,3),(2,3)),'Inside invariant text allowing a2x2 or rectangle, but outside exact2x2 SUMMARY/validator; one available step.','Expose conflicting rectangle versus exact2x2 contracts.')
add('zero_step_up',make(6,8,rect(0,3),(2,3)),'Outside invariant requiring at leastoneavailable step; adjacent bottomanchor and blob already at upperwall.','Validator accepts unsupported zero-step upward endpoint.')
add('zero_step_down',make(6,8,rect(4,3),(3,3)),'Outside invariant requiring at leastoneavailable step; adjacent topanchor and blob already at lowerwall.','Validator accepts unsupported zero-step downward endpoint.')
for case in cases:
    try:case['self_check_messages']=gen.self_check(case['input'])
    except Exception as exc:case['self_check_exception']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)}
assert len(cases)<=64
(out/'input.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs':[c['input'] for c in cases]},indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps({'task_id':'7860069b4149','generator_sha256':sha,'version':gen.VERSION,'rule_hash':public['rule_hash'],'cases':cases},indent=2)+'\n')
overrides=[]
for kw in ({'grid_h':5},{'grid_h':12},{'grid_w':6},{'grid_w':14},{'grid_h':6,'grid_w':8},{'anchor_side':'left'}):
    row={'call':{'seed':0,'sample_index':0,'difficulty':'medium','overrides':kw},'declared_valid_axis_values':True}
    try:
        g=gen.generate(0,0,difficulty='medium',**kw)
        row.update({'outcome':'returned','shape':[len(g),len(g[0])],'self_check_messages':gen.self_check(g)})
    except Exception as exc:row.update({'outcome':'exception','exception_type':type(exc).__name__,'exception_message':str(exc)})
    overrides.append(row)
(out/'override_results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'generator_sha256':sha,'cases':overrides},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'input_count':len(cases),'generated_count':sum(c['kind']=='generated' for c in cases),'generated_unique_inputs':len({json.dumps(c['input']) for c in cases if c['kind']=='generated'}),'validator_results':{c['name']:c.get('self_check_messages',c.get('self_check_exception')) for c in cases if c['kind']!='generated'},'override_results':overrides},indent=2))

import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/scratch/f9e780997a95/round2');out=root/'WORK/checks/audit/7860069b4149'
sha=hashlib.sha256((root/'WORK/repo/generators/7860069b4149/generator.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha=='e9afb2c4e143072bf7f80044d40ed96eb6524615c5e7a5d17f294dcbb6d95a04'
authority=json.loads((out/'racket.json').read_text());analysis=json.loads((out/'analysis.json').read_text());commands=json.loads((out/'commands.json').read_text());overrides=json.loads((out/'override_results.json').read_text())
assert len(authority['results'])==24 and all(r['valid_output'] and r['error'] is None for r in authority['results'])
assert authority['generator_sha256']==sha and authority['executed_rule_hash']=='a527b7e705e3'
assert analysis['canonical_reexecution_matches_labels'] and analysis['generated_probe']['unique_inputs']==10
assert sum(c['outcome']=='exception' for c in overrides['cases'])==4
assert all(row['exit_code']==0 for row in commands)
for row in commands:
    for rel in row['evidence_paths']:assert (root/rel).is_file(),rel
byname={r['name']:r for r in analysis['cases']}
assert byname['one_step_right']['self_check_messages']==['blob needs room to sweep right']
assert byname['one_step_right']['actual_racket_output']!=byname['one_step_right']['input']
assert byname['zero_step_up']['self_check_messages']==[] and byname['zero_step_up']['actual_racket_output']==byname['zero_step_up']['input']
assert byname['zero_step_down']['self_check_messages']==[] and byname['zero_step_down']['actual_racket_output']==byname['zero_step_down']['input']
assert byname['upward_2x2']['self_check_messages']==[] and not byname['upward_2x2']['rivals']['no_up_sweep']['matches']
assert not byname['concave_scanline_gap']['rivals']['scanline_envelope']['matches']
assert (out/'audit_section.md').read_text().startswith('## 7860069b4149\n')
artifacts=[]
for p in sorted(out.iterdir()):
    if not p.is_file() or p.name in ('commands.json','receipt.json'):continue
    artifacts.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(root/'WORK')),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
receipt={'finding_id':'A2','task_id':'7860069b4149','generator_sha256':sha,'rule_hash':authority['executed_rule_hash'],'rule_text_sha256':authority['rule_text_sha256'],'reference_valid_outputs':24,'canonical_labelled_pairs':3,'generated_draws':12,'generated_unique_inputs':10,'authored_inputs':9,'declared_valid_override_exceptions':4,'source_unchanged':True,'prior_commands_zero_exit':len(commands),'artifacts':artifacts,'total_artifact_bytes_excluding_commands_and_receipt':sum(a['bytes'] for a in artifacts),'disposition':'findings_only_reproduced_validator_override_defects_with_qualified_domain_shortcut'}
(out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k!='artifacts'},indent=2))
